relation_metrics.macro_f1: unweighted mean F1 over classes with truth support > 0 (ENTAILS, CONTRADICTS, PARTIAL, RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT, AMBIGUOUS)
relation_metrics.insufficient_recall: true RBI predicted RBI / true RBI
relation_metrics.critical_false_entails: count of critical:true cases predicted ENTAILS with truth not ENTAILS
relation_metrics.critical_false_contradicts: count of critical:true cases predicted CONTRADICTS with truth not CONTRADICTS

diagnostic_metrics.RELATION_ACCURACY_WITHIN_BLOCKED_GATE: accuracy over atoms whose boundary projection is BOUNDARY_BLOCKED
diagnostic_metrics.RELATION_ACCURACY_WITHIN_UNRESOLVED_GATE: accuracy over atoms whose boundary projection is BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED

numeric_metrics.numeric_entails_precision: true ENTAILS / predicted ENTAILS on numeric subset
numeric_metrics.numeric_contradicts_precision: true CONTRADICTS / predicted CONTRADICTS on numeric subset
numeric_metrics.quantity_identity_accuracy: gold quantity_identity matches predicted relation resolving identity (ENTAILS/CONTRADICTS vs RBI)
numeric_metrics.comparator_accuracy: expected comparator_entails field vs predicted numeric direction
numeric_metrics.law_reference_numeric_errors: law-ref numbers treated as quantities causing wrong verdict
